problem: A clean Supabase PR Preview could not replay canonical migrations from zero. First, terminal_health_lifecycle_v2 assumed a historical P0 desired-state row that existed only in production. After fixing that baseline, publication_authority_pgcrypto_qualification referenced the Instagram daily-winner rowtype before the table was created.
root_cause: Production contained historically pre-existing state/schema that was never captured at the point where later migrations depended on it. Incremental production migration succeeded, but deterministic clean replay was not guaranteed.
prevention: Every migration dependency must be present in migration history before first use, even if production already has the object or row.
Historical data baselines must be reconstructed only from production evidence and inserted idempotently.
Schema replay baselines may create exact canonical object shapes early with IF NOT EXISTS; later canonical migrations retain RLS, grants and behavior authority.
Supabase Preview failures must be reproduced on a clean recreated preview branch before declaring migration history healthy.
failed_approaches: Rebasing a failed preview branch without recreating it from a clean migration replay.
Assuming incremental production success proves migrations replay from zero.
